analysis: The API method is List.get(int index) which throws IndexOutOfBoundsException if index < 0 or index >= list size. In the code snippet, the only call to get is inside a for loop with i from 0 to formats.length-1. Before each call to arguments.get(i), there is a check: if (arguments.size() > i). This ensures that i is less than the list size. Since i is always >=0, the condition index < 0 is also avoided. Therefore, the IndexOutOfBoundsException is fully avoided by the prior size check.
answer: IndexOutOfBoundsException: Its throwing condition is avoided by the check arguments.size() > i before calling get.
remark: No exceptions are in the result because the only declared exception, IndexOutOfBoundsException, is avoided by the size check before calling get.
